Sonatype IQ Server

Applications, organizations, policies and policy evaluations on Sonatype IQ Server

skills/toil/sonatypeiq.md

Applications, organizations and policies on Sonatype IQ Server, read through its REST API (/api/v2/...), and a policy evaluation of a dependency inventory against one application. Nothing here changes anything in IQ Server. Verification level: unit.

Supported versions: The oldest Sonatype IQ Server version toil supports hasn’t been established. toil calls only /api/v2 endpoints, with a user token pair sent as HTTP Basic. No release has been verified yet.

Credential

An IQ Server user token: in IQ Server, open your profile and choose User Token, then create one. It has two halves, a user code and a passcode. toil sends them as Authorization: Basic base64(userCode:passcode). It is not your login password, and there is no browser login.

Configuration

KeyEnv varRequiredMeaning
baseUrlTOIL_SONATYPEIQ_BASE_URLyesSonatype IQ Server root, e.g. https://iq.imagile.dev (keep any context path)
userCodeTOIL_SONATYPEIQ_USER_CODEyesUser token code
passcodeTOIL_SONATYPEIQ_PASSCODEyesUser token passcode (a secret)

There’s no CI fallback variable.

Environment variables (CI, or a one-off shell):

export TOIL_SONATYPEIQ_BASE_URL=https://iq.imagile.dev
export TOIL_SONATYPEIQ_USER_CODE=<your user code>
export TOIL_SONATYPEIQ_PASSCODE=<your passcode>

Or ~/.toil/config.json:

{
  "version": 2,
  "connections": {
    "corp-iq": { "area": "sonatypeiq", "baseUrl": "https://iq.imagile.dev", "userCode": "abc12345" }
  },
  "defaults": { "sonatypeiq": { "connection": "corp-iq" } }
}

The passcode never goes in this file; a plaintext one there is refused with CONFIG_INVALID. Run toil connections add corp-iq --area sonatypeiq (or toil connections login corp-iq for an existing connection) to keep it in the OS credential store, or set TOIL_SONATYPEIQ_PASSCODE.

Commands

The four read commands return IQ Server’s answer unchanged as data.

  • applications list: List all applications in Sonatype IQ Server (--organization-id <id>, sent as an organizationId query parameter, which IQ may ignore).
  • applications get --public-id <id>: Get an application by its public ID. data is the filtered list, { applications: [...] }; an unknown ID gives an empty list, not an error.
  • organizations list: List all organizations in Sonatype IQ Server.
  • policies list: List all policies (--organization-id <id> asks /api/v2/policies/organization/<id>).
  • evaluate (also toil deps frisk --source sonatypeiq): Evaluate a dependency inventory against an application’s policies. --application-id <id> (required) is the application’s public ID. data is { tier, source, sourcesQueried, sourceErrors, scanned, vulnerable, packages }, each package with its vulnerabilities.

evaluate reads the inventory that toil deps scan writes, from --from <file> or, when that’s left out on the CLI, from piped stdin (with nothing piped in on a terminal it refuses at once rather than wait); over MCP, pass from. Use deps scan --include-transitive to evaluate transitive dependencies too. --ecosystem npm|nuget|maven|all (default all), --direct-only and --include-dev filter the inventory first. toil deps frisk --source sonatypeiq takes the same flags and runs this command.

It looks up the application’s internal ID by public ID (if the lookup fails or finds nothing, the public ID is used as it is), then posts the packages as package URLs, 128 at a time. If IQ answers that the evaluation is queued, toil polls the resultsUrl up to 10 times, waiting 2 s longer each time, and fails if it’s still queued. A resultsUrl on another host is fetched from the connection’s host instead, with a SONATYPEIQ_RESULTS_HOST warning. Only SECURITY policy violations count, with threat level 9 or more as CRITICAL, 7 HIGH, 4 MEDIUM and above 0 LOW. The command is allowed up to 600 s.

meta.warnings says SONATYPEIQ_NO_COMPONENTS when IQ’s answer had no components list to read findings from, and SONATYPEIQ_UNMATCHED_RESULT for a result that matches no package sent. Either means the result may undercount.

toil sonatypeiq applications list
toil sonatypeiq applications get --public-id imagile-api
toil deps scan --include-transitive | toil sonatypeiq evaluate --application-id imagile-api
toil sonatypeiq evaluate --from inventory.json --application-id imagile-api --ecosystem npm

Settings at a glance

  • baseUrl required

    Sonatype IQ Server root, e.g. https://iq.imagile.dev

    TOIL_SONATYPEIQ_BASE_URL

  • userCode required

    User token code

    TOIL_SONATYPEIQ_USER_CODE

  • passcode required secret

    User token passcode

    TOIL_SONATYPEIQ_PASSCODE

Commands at a glance

  • toil sonatypeiqapplications list

    List all applications in Sonatype IQ Server

    MCP sonatypeiq_applications_list--organization-id <id>

  • toil sonatypeiqapplications get

    Get an application by its public ID

    MCP sonatypeiq_applications_get--public-id <id>

  • toil sonatypeiqorganizations list

    List all organizations in Sonatype IQ Server

    MCP sonatypeiq_organizations_list

  • toil sonatypeiqpolicies list

    List all policies

    MCP sonatypeiq_policies_list--organization-id <id>

  • toil sonatypeiqevaluate

    Evaluate a dependency inventory against a Sonatype IQ Server application's policies

    MCP sonatypeiq_evaluate--from <file>--application-id <id>--ecosystem <ecosystem>--direct-only--include-dev
